decision_call_instructions: Choose one listed repair scope for the current public failure. Apply state.instructions and the exact candidate scopes in state.candidates. Select stop if no safe legal scope is supported.
decision_instructions: Choose an exact legal repair scope using the current public assertion observations, the producer-to-representation-to-renderer contracts, and the observed repair history. A public output failure identifies a symptom, not necessarily its faulty owner. Compare where the required source value is introduced, represented, and rendered. Causal paths are explicit public-contract hypotheses with bound artifact owners; they are not proof that every connected file is faulty. Prefer the smallest scope that can restore the original requirement across the evidenced path. A repeated assertion after a prior change is evidence that the previous scope or change was insufficient; do not infer that repeating the same patch will work. Read-only access does not authorize writing or add a DAG dependency. Choose stop if the supplied observations and legal scopes cannot support a safe repair. All original and new public checks will be rerun; no requirement or assertion may be weakened.
worker_instructions: Repair only the selected artifact paths. Trace the original required value through the supplied producer, representation and renderer interfaces before changing a consumer. Read current declared inputs normally and inspect additional causal artifacts only through their supplied immutable failure-baseline read sources. Do not claim that a path was inspected if its bytes were unavailable. Keep distinct source fields distinct; do not substitute a schema/model description for a request-body description. Use the observed prior changes and persistent failures to avoid repeating an insufficient patch. Do not hardcode fixture values, weaken public tests, widen writes, or edit read-only artifacts. Preserve all nonselected bytes and executable modes; a wider repair needs another legal controller decision.

candidate_reasons.producer: Repair only the evidenced producer artifacts that introduce the source value; inspect the connected representation and renderers read-only. Other failures remain unresolved until all checks rerun.
candidate_reasons.representation: Repair only the evidenced representation artifacts that carry the source value; inspect the connected producers and renderers read-only. Other failures remain unresolved until all checks rerun.
candidate_reasons.renderer: Repair only the evidenced renderer artifacts; inspect the connected producers and representation read-only. A renderer workaround is insufficient if the required source value never reaches it.
candidate_reasons.producer-representation: Repair the evidenced producer and representation artifacts together; inspect renderers read-only and preserve unrelated artifacts.
candidate_reasons.chain: Repair the complete explicitly evidenced producer-to-representation-to-renderer path, with exact artifact writes. This scope covers the public contract path, not every task in the project.

rules.unsupported_or_stale_causal_mapping: retain explicit direct fallback and record unresolved; never invent a path
rules.unknown_all_worker_fallback: exclude when based only on unresolved ownership
rules.read_basis: extra reads use verified immutable failure-baseline snapshots; existing declared inputs retain current runtime revisions
rules.history_basis: controller-observed public failures, exact selected scopes and before/after artifact and file hashes
